I am happy classes are over, but that now means i'll have to leave soon :(
we went to Target today. it was finally a good company visit. it's located in a technology park where it's really nice and reminds me of the bay area. this was the first time we've seen nice buildings in Bangalore. we walked in and it was like walking into an American company- finally we were seeing what the companies are like. Target is only in the US and although they don't have plans to expand outside, they have 2K employees in India who do marketing, analytics, etc, same as in the US.
afterwards we went to Ruby Tuesday. OK, go ahead and give me shit again, i deserve it this time. the food was terrible! the artichoke dip was soupy like cream of mushroom, and the chicken mini burgers were nasty. note to self and everyone reading, if you need real American food, only go to Hard Rock- they won't let you down! apparently no one dances here either. this girl Megha said she ready a review about a disco where people were dancing and someone yelled "police!" and everyone sat down really quick- exactly what happened to us last weekend. we went shopping after dinner and were asking people where we could go dancing, they said no where. apparently dancing is frowned upon. i bought more crap tonight. i must stop- i'm not going to fit all my shit in my bags.
tomorrow night is our farewell dinner and all us gals are wearing saris (spelled sarees here). can't wait to have a bunch of material stuck in my pants and falling off- it's going to be very comfortable. we're going to have to party down since it's our last night in India!! not sure how i'm going to dance in a sari, maybe that's why peeps don't dance here. i'll have to figure that one out...
i'm also buying a drawing tomorrow from Mani- that awesome guy we visited last week. looking forward to that. sad thing that we'll probably end back at the Oberoi Hotel and have $20 cocktails just because its so nice there. oh well, only 4 days left of my vaca.
i can't wait to get to Singapore and eat some sushi! after losing weight, i've now gained it back from drinking every night and eating the heavy ass Indian food. i don't know how people live off this stuff, it can't be good for you. the only veggies i've eaten were fried and didn't taste like much. sorry my posts are getting lame- i'll try to get into some shenanigans tomorrow night to keep things interesting- i won't let you down!!
